MI SB 1190 — Michigan Eyes Lower-Carbon Fuels, Sets 2035 Goal

Michigan is considering a new standard to cut the greenhouse gas emissions from transportation fuels. By 2035, the state aims to reduce the carbon intensity of all fuels – including gasoline, diesel, and aviation fuel – by at least 35% compared to 2019 levels. ...
